report.summary: The investigation identified a sustained memory usage spike in the payments service, reaching 86% (ALR-001) during the incident window. Metrics confirm a gradual increase in memory_pct (MET-00021, MET-01930, MET-01976) and CPU usage (MET-01285, MET-01308, MET-01331), but no direct OutOfMemory errors or memory-related logs were found. Database pool utilization (MET-00828, MET-00851) remained elevated but did not show exhaustion. Orders service logs (LOG-01248) indicate failures calling payments, suggesting downstream impact but no direct evidence of connection pool exhaustion in payments. No configuration errors or deployment issues were explicitly logged.
